bibliographic.title: Confirmation of the monoclinic Cc space group for the ground state phase of Pb(Zr0.525Ti0.475)O3 (PZT525): A Combined Synchrotron X-Ray and Neutron Powder Diffraction Study

bibliographic.abstract: The low temperature antiferrodistortive phase transition in a pseudo-tetragonal composition of PZT with x=0.525 is investigated through a combined synchrotron x-ray and neutron powder diffraction study. It is shown that the superlattice peaks cannot be correctly accounted for in the Rietveld refinement using R3c or R3c+Cm structural models, whereas the Cc space group gives excellent fits to the superlattice peaks as well as to the perovskite peaks. This settles at rest the existing controversies about the structure of the ground state phase of PZT in the MPB region.

datasets.dataset_description: High resolution synchrotron X-ray diffraction data obtained at wavelength of 1.543 Å to investigate perovskite reflections from 10-700K.
Neutron powder diffraction experiments (λ=2.536 Å) carried out on high resolution SPODI powder diffractometer to capture superlattice reflections.
